content.text:
# SCN-A greenfield: per-link analytics summary endpoint

Requirement version 1 (greenfield).

## Behaviour
- Add a per-link analytics summary endpoint GET /api/v1/links/{code}/analytics/summary returning total redirects, first and last redirect time, and redirects per day.
- Unknown codes return 404.
- Expired links keep their analytics readable.

## Acceptance criteria
- AC-01: Add a per-link analytics summary endpoint GET /api/v1/links/{code}/analytics/summary returning total redirects, first and last redirect time, and redirects per day. — observable: endpoint exists in the OpenAPI contract and returns the stated fields
- AC-02: Unknown codes return 404. — observable: HTTP response status is 404
- AC-03: Expired links keep their analytics readable. — observable: an expired link is not redirected; its status is observable

## API impact
- api_or_schema_impact: True
- contract version impact: minor (additive)
